checks.name: aac-priming-correction-is-audio-only
checks.run:
from mission_control.video_edit_rendering import concat_argv
native={'tools':{'ffmpeg':'ffmpeg'}}
audio=concat_argv(native,True)
silent=concat_argv(native,False)
assert isinstance(audio,list) and '-output_ts_offset' in audio, 'Retained AAC must compile its priming correction'
assert isinstance(silent,list) and '-output_ts_offset' not in silent, 'Silent output must not receive an AAC offset'
assert abs(float(audio[audio.index('-output_ts_offset')+1])+1024/48000)<1e-10, 'AAC48kHz correction must match the fixed encoder delay'

checks.name: real-full-length-source-job-and-decode
checks.run:
import unittest
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.test_media_duration')
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
assert result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped, 'Actual full-length single/stitch/mute decode and source limits must pass'
